name: pf_states
description: Reads the pf state table (Firewall > Diagnostics > States) at a cadence and stores the current rate by protocol and destination port: the bytes each state carried between two reads, over the seconds between them. A second measure, sampled, never summed with the logged volume.

endpoints.name: query_states
endpoints.survey_section: Live rate endpoints, read from source for C3 (backend completion)
endpoints.note: Read action (queryStatesAction): configd 'filter list states', list_states.py over lib/states.py's query_states, which runs /sbin/pfctl -vvs state. Every call walks the whole state table whatever page is asked. Answers {rows, rowCount, total, current}; each row carries id (state id/creator id), iface, proto, direction (in|out), src_addr, src_port, dst_addr, dst_port, nat_addr, nat_port, state, age (hh:mm:ss), expires, label, and pkts and bytes as cumulative [0, 1] pairs since the state was created: [0] counts the packets in the state's own direction, from the initiator, [1] the reverse (pf.c, s->bytes[s_dir_rev]).
